newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: State agency accused of seizing Pakistani journalist.
newsitem.headline: State agency accused of seizing Pakistani journalist.

text.p: The journalists union in Islamabad said on Sunday that some Pakistani state agency had seized a local journalist and was holding him incommunicado 24 hours later.
Relatives said plainclothes men and a uniformed policeman picked up Humayun Far, Islamabad bureau chief of the Urdu-language daily Mashriq, near his home on Saturday night.

The local journalist union issued a statement describing the incident an attack on press freedom. "Whatever official agency or department has kidnapped Humayun Far, the government should immediately get him released immediately," it said.
Far's wife said Islamabad police had refused to register a kidnapping complaint. No police comment was immediately available.
